services.tagline: Healthy skin starts with the right care.
services.imageAlt: Facial treatment at Billy Aura Wellness Studio

items.name: Glow Facial
items.description: A refreshing facial with cleansing, gentle exfoliation, a nourishing mask and a relaxing facial massage. Suitable for clients looking for a simple skin refresh.

items.name: Clarifying Facial
items.description: A deep-cleansing facial focused on oily and congested skin. Includes cleansing, suitable exfoliation, and extractions when appropriate, followed by calming skincare.

items.name: Lumière Signature Facial
items.description: A personalised facial experience combining skin cleansing, selected skincare, facial massage and a mask chosen for your skin's needs. Additional treatments, including LED, may be offered when available and suitable.

items.name: HydraFacial
items.description: A professional treatment designed to cleanse, exfoliate and hydrate the skin using specialised equipment. Available once the equipment, training and treatment protocols are in place.

items.name: Laser Skin Treatments
items.description: Professional laser treatments for selected skin concerns. Treatment options will be confirmed after appropriate training, skin assessment and a suitability consultation.
